rob: Quick postmortem follow-up for the Dedicated tenant outage — root cause: VPC peering config + on-prem NAT rewrite. Postmortem: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-01-dedicated-peering|2026-01-dedicated-peering>.
ops-bot: postmortem published by @rob.
maya: thanks. What's remaining?
rob: Open actions:
- ACT-1201: enforce preserve-src-ip in peering policy (owner: @rob)
- ACT-1202: customer KB with NAT examples and blockers (owner: @natalie)
- ACT-1203: synthetic test for asymmetric return path (owner: @evan)
- ACT-1204: route-flap alert + circuit-breaker (owner: @maya)
natalie: need the exact NAT rule example to show customers. Can someone paste a minimal repro snippet?
evans: minimal repro: packet to KV node gets SNATed at edge -> return path goes to different AS -> TCP session reset -> replication timeout. Repro harness attached to INF-1201.
maya: I'll add the alert: "peering.return_path_mismatch" -> page eng-sre, set threshold 3 events/5m. Also adding a short-circuit on pool nodes to divert traffic if we detect mismatch.
rob: timeline: peering policy canary by 2026-01-30, full rollout 2026-02-06. Runbook/Kb by 2026-01-22. Tests and alerts by 2026-01-28. I'll attach INF-1201 epic shortly.
natalie: drafting KB now, will include CLI checks and traceroute examples. Share draft by Friday.
evans: adding synthetic test to CI next sprint, will tag infra owners.
rob: also note this pattern occurred twice in past year; recommend recurring quarterly peering audits for Dedicated / Private customers. Will propose in GTM review.
maya: ack, will track monitoring PR and link here when ready.
rob: thanks all, weekly sync on Tuesdays. Reopening thread when owners report progress.
